_doc: Authoritative fixed values for figma-create-section. The snippet has a {{placeholder}} for every value here. The calling skill MUST read this file and substitute all placeholders before executing the snippet. Edit values HERE only — never inline in the snippet.

section.comment: #FFFFFF white, 12px corner radius (section default is 2). A Figma SECTION supports fill + cornerRadius but NO padding and NO auto-layout — that is why there is no inner frame; the headline is positioned directly.

headline.comment: Headline placed inset px from the section's top-left (section-relative coords). inset is also the content padding callers should respect on all sides.

placement.comment: Auto mode (no placement.besideNodeId input): section placed offsetRight px right of the rightmost existing node, else origin (0, originY). BesideNode mode (placement.besideNodeId given): section placed besideGap px right of that node's bounding box, top-aligned to it.
